criterionOutcomes.reason: No independent versioned expected definition identifies the HTTP/Ping/Video groups, categories, thresholds, exact colours, shapes or outlines. criterion-1-final.png shows the current HTTP lower groups, not their correctness against configuration. criterionOutcomes.criterion: Numeric Value fields use number inputs. Empty, non-finite, out-of-limit or incorrectly ordered boundary values show an inline error immediately and disable Save. HTTP Browsing boundaries accept 0–10,000; Ping and Video Streaming boundaries have a minimum of zero and no additional maximum. Video Streaming categories cannot be changed.
criterionOutcomes.reason: HTTP criterion-11-http-order-settled.png directly shows first boundary 13 before next boundary 12, without an inline ordering error; Save appears enabled. Video criterion-11-video-editor.png -> criterion-11-video-category-draft.png -> criterion-11-final.png directly shows exact category 1 edited and saved as 1.5 in both editor and legend, contradicting fixed categories. HTTP empty, 1e999, -1 and 10001 captures show required/minimum/maximum messages and muted Save; Ping/Video -1 captures show minimum-zero messages. Their blocked-Save claims lack normal pointer/applicable keyboard activation and settled after-state proof. Numeric spinner controls are visible. Boundary acceptance and unlimited maxima are only partially exercised: Ping/Video 1000000 accepted-looking drafts do not alone establish absence of every additional cap, and HTTP valid endpoint acceptance lacks its own captures.
